Chinese-name subset of GeoNames cities5000 (downloaded 2026-10-10).
Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Records retain GeoNames IDs, WGS84 coordinates, country, admin1, population and aliases.
This is a derived name index, not administrative boundaries or a complete address directory.
